correctness.rationale: Direct coordinate/node-plane incidence reconstruction yields the full 45x40 binary matrix with 360 edges; a second construction over F7 confirms every entry. Exact exhaustive Gram identity gives eigenvalues 72,12,0 of multiplicities 1,24,20; the Laplacian matrix-tree theorem gives order 2^108 3^54 5^23. Exact invertible Smith operations over Z/p^12 for p=2,3,5, two deleted sinks, yield prime valuations whose sums exactly match the independently derived order. Sorting and multiplying gives 40 units and 44 nonunits as claimed. Proof limits: only this finite graph; no infinite-family result.

value.rationale: The graph canonically captures all node-Jacobi-plane flags of a classical algebraic-geometric quartic. The integral critical group, the finite chip-firing divisor-class invariant, is natural and useful independently of any downstream theorem. Its complete 44-factor mixed-primary structure is not implied by the rational Gram spectrum, tree count, or prior rectangular incidence cokernel and supplies a reference invariant for symmetry and arithmetic descent problems. The object and invariant are motivated before computation, not an arbitrary slice.
